Decision: Pay Per Ride/Minute  
**Justification**: For 3 selected trips, pay-per-use totals $5.85 vs. $29/monthly membership. The break-even point is ~15 rides/month ($29 ÷ $1.95/ride). With 3 rides, pay-per-use is cheaper.  
**Cost Breakdown**:  
- Pay-per-use: $5.85 (includes $1 unlock fee + $0.19/minute).  
- Membership: $29/month (includes 45 minutes; additional minutes cost $0.17/minute).  
**Assumptions**: Trip durations and pricing align with official rates. No data on ride lengths or membership tiers beyond base pricing.  
**Caveats**: Membership may save money for >15 rides/month.
